ammonia.reason: Very limited deamination and proteolysis under 19-20% brine and 10% salt in cheese inhibits ammonia release.

animal_barnyard.reason: Trace sheep-milk p-cresol/indole present but boiling and high-salt brine limit barnyard development.

bitter.reason: Rennet-derived hydrophobic peptides present but low proteolysis at young age and 10% salt masks bitterness.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti added and no piercing; methyl ketones 2-heptanone/2-nonanone absent.

browning.reason: Low residual lactose after whey loss and boiling limits Maillard; slight browning only on frying.

buttery.reason: Made without starter culture so no citrate fermentation to diacetyl/acetoin; boiling strips residual diketones.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Pasteurized milk plus 10% salt suppresses lipase activity and butyric/hexanoic free fatty acid release.

creaminess.reason: 24.7% fat but boiled high-salt protein matrix with low proteolysis limits fat-coated creamy mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Pressed boiled curd at pH 6.43 retains colloidal calcium cohesion, slices rather than crumbles like feta.

firmness.reason: 43.35% moisture with pressing, boiling and 10% salt calcium-paracasein crosslinking gives dense semi-hard body.

floral_honey.reason: Minimal phenylalanine catabolism without starter; phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol near absent.

fruity.reason: High salt with no esterifying LAB/yeast suppresses ethyl butanoate/hexanoate synthesis.

goaty.reason: Mixed sheep/cow milk caprylic/capric acids give mild sheepy note without intense goat 4-ethyloctanoic character.

malty_nutty.reason: Minimal proteolysis and Strecker degradation under high salt and no starter limits 3-methylbutanal formation.

melt.reason: Boiled whey-protein coating plus 10% NaCl dehydration of paracasein prevents flow on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No bloomy or washed rind flora; 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one from linoleate oxidation absent.

oil_off.reason: Firm boiled protein network entraps 24.7% fat, minimal free oil release despite heating.

smoky.reason: Not smoked; volatile phenols like guaiacol absent.

sour_vinegar.reason: No starter acidification, cheese pH 6.43; acetic acid only minor from residual lactose fermentation.

stretch.reason: Rennet high-pH curd not acidified to pH 5.2-5.4 and not pasta-filata stretched; boiled network resists extension.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Boiling curd in salted whey denatures beta-lactoglobulin releasing H2S, methional and dimethyl sulfide.

sweet.reason: Most lactose lost in whey and boiling; residual lactose sweetness suppressed by 9.96% salt.

umami.reason: Low glutamate release from rennet-only limited proteolysis under high salt; NaCl enhances savoriness slightly.
